_readme: Keys created by the latent-bug pass: the brand split out of the loading line, the offline copy
that used to name the wrong app, the scale-chip severity words that an array index used to pick,
and the Kp meaning line whose forecast clause was an English fragment no catalog could reach.
The 'N OF 7 SOURCES' badge carries no plural rule on purpose: the noun agrees with the TOTAL
(always 7), and every locale here is phrased so nothing agrees with the failing count. That is
sturdier than a two-argument plural substitution, which would have to inflect on argument 1
